title_ar: الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو يترأس إحدى جلسات مؤتمر رابطة العالم الإسلامي بمكة المكرمة
title_en: Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew Chairs One of the Sessions of the Muslim World League Conference in Mecca
body_ar:
شارك الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء في المؤتمر الذي تعقده رابطة العالم الإسلامي في مكة المكرمة تحت عنوان: " العالم الإسلامي .. المشكلات والحلول". وقد استأنف المؤتمر أعماله مساء يوم الأحد 23 / 8 / 1432 هـ.

ترأس الشيخ الددو الجلسة الرابعة من جلسات المؤتمر وهي تحت عنوان: " تكامل جهود العلماء والمؤسسات الدينية والتربوية والثقافية والإعلامية في إصلاح المجتمعات".

وقد ركز الباحثون في هذه الجلسة التي يرأسها الشيخ الددو على ثلاثة جوانب متصلة بإصلاح المجتمعات ومن أهمها:

• الأنموذج الشرعي للحكم الإسلامي وأثره في صياغة المسلم وبناء المجتمعات وتحقيق أمنها واستقرارها.

• ضرورة وضع صيغة لعمل ميداني يتحقق من خلالها العمل الإسلامي المشترك في خدمة المجتمعات الإسلامية.

• دعم المنظمات الدينية والثقافية ووسائل الإعلام لجهود العلماء وقادة الرأي في نشر قيم الاعتدال والتوسط والحوار البناء بين المسلمين.

• الأنموذج السعودي في تطبيق شريعة الإسلام وأثره المشهود في تحقيق الأمن والاستقرار والتعاون بين فئات الشعب، والتواصل المتميز بينهم وبين ولاة الأمر.

وتمثلت مشاركة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء في الجلسة السابعة من جلسات المؤتمر ضمن محور الحوار في المجتمعات الإسلامية في تقديمه لموضوع تحت عنوان: " الحوار وأثره على وحدة الأمة المسلمة".

وسينشر الموقع لاحقا - بإذن الله – مشاركة الشيخ في المؤتمر.

ونشير إلى أن هذا المؤتمر سيتم تنظيمه دوريا في المستقبل كل سنة لبحث قضايا الأمة الإسلامية؛ ذلك ما وعد به خادم الحرمين الشريفين الملك عبد الله بن عبد العزيز آل سعود في اليوم الأول من المؤتمر خلال استقباله للمشاركين في المؤتمر بالقصر الملكي بجدة.
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, took part in the conference held by the Muslim World League in Mecca under the title "The Muslim world: the problems and the solutions". The conference resumed its work on the evening of Sunday 23/8/1432 AH.

Sheikh al-Dedew chaired the fourth of the conference's sessions, which was under the title "The complementarity of the efforts of scholars and of religious, educational, cultural and media institutions in the reform of societies".

In this session, which Sheikh al-Dedew chaired, the researchers concentrated on three aspects bearing on the reform of societies, the most important of them being:

• The Sharia model of Islamic governance and its effect in forming the Muslim, in building societies, and in achieving their security and stability.

• The necessity of drawing up a formula for field work through which joint Islamic action in the service of Muslim societies may be realised.

• Support by religious and cultural organisations and by the media for the efforts of scholars and opinion leaders in spreading the values of moderation, of the middle way, and of constructive dialogue among Muslims.

• The Saudi model in the application of the Sharia of Islam, and its manifest effect in achieving security, stability and cooperation among the sections of the people, and the distinguished communication between them and those in authority.

The participation of Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, took the form — in the seventh of the conference's sessions, within the strand on dialogue in Muslim societies — of his presentation of a paper under the title "Dialogue and its effect on the unity of the Muslim community".

The site will publish the Sheikh's contribution to the conference later, God willing.

We note that this conference is to be organised periodically in future, every year, to examine the issues of the Islamic community. That is what the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, King ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz Al Saʿud, promised on the first day of the conference, during his reception of the conference participants at the royal palace in Jeddah.

flags.arabic: وقد ركز الباحثون في هذه الجلسة التي يرأسها الشيخ الددو على ثلاثة جوانب … • الأنموذج السعودي في تطبيق شريعة الإسلام وأثره المشهود في تحقيق الأمن والاستقرار
flags.context: the four bullets said to be what the session's researchers concentrated on
options: display with an explicit note that the bullets are the conference papers' positions, not the Sheikh's
display as an ordinary news item
flags.note: CRITICAL — critical_for_display and editorial_review. The four bullets are what the researchers in the session put forward; the Sheikh chaired the session and his own contribution was a different paper, given in the seventh session. Nothing in the record says he endorsed any of this. The fourth bullet in particular — praise of the Saudi state's application of the Sharia and of relations between the people and those in authority — is a conference paper's claim, and the record's structure makes it easy for an English reader to take it for the Sheikh's own view because his name appears in the same sentence that introduces the list. Attributing that endorsement to him in English would be a serious misrepresentation with reputational consequences for him. The English keeps the attribution to الباحثون ('the researchers') explicit; the site must not let the layout undo that.

flags.arabic: على ثلاثة جوانب متصلة بإصلاح المجتمعات ومن أهمها:
flags.context: the sentence introducing the bullet list
options: translate as given ('three aspects') and flag the mismatch
flags.note: The source says three aspects and then lists four bullets. Not corrected, per style guide section 11. Either a bullet was added later or one of the four is a sub-point; the record does not say which.

اعتدال and توسط are near-synonyms in this register and English tends to collapse them into one word. Both are kept distinct here, with توسط rendered by 'the middle way' to preserve its link to the Qur'anic ummah wasaṭ that underlies the term. Flagged so that the corpus fixes one pair of renderings.

options: keep the hijri date exactly as given, with no Gregorian equivalent
give the hijri date with a Gregorian equivalent in brackets
flags.note: The source gives only the hijri date. It has been kept as given and no conversion has been inserted into the body; 23 Shaʿban 1432 corresponds to about 24 July 2011, which is consistent with the record's timestamp. Whether to add Gregorian equivalents is a house decision for the whole corpus, not a per-record one.

translator_notes: This is a news report by the site's news desk. Nothing in it is given as the Sheikh's own words, and no ruling is stated anywhere in it, so the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not engaged.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written.

الأنموذج الشرعي للحكم الإسلامي is rendered 'the Sharia model of Islamic governance'. شرعي is kept as an adjective of the Sharia rather than translated as 'legitimate', which would smuggle in an endorsement the Arabic does not make at this point.
The Sheikh's own conference paper is named but not reproduced; the record says the site would publish it later. The paper itself is not in this record.
